slides.texte_overlay:
Little things that make you
the boyfriend she brags about
Learning her coffee order by heart. Bringing it unexpectedly on a busy morning shows you pay attention to the little things that make her day.
Being friendly with her friends. Chat with them, remember their stories, make them laugh. When her friends like you, she feels proud to have you there.
Taking her ideas seriously. When she shares a plan or a dream, ask questions and encourage her. Being her biggest supporter matters more than any gift.
Keeping romance alive on normal days. A slow dance in the kitchen, a note in her bag, a surprise picnic. Small romance beats expensive gestures.
Before: our dates felt routine. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and new ideas for places to explore and things to talk about together.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: our dates felt routine. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. Now I always have new ideas for us to explore together.

slides.texte_overlay: Defending her when she's not there. If someone criticises her, stand up for her calmly. Loyalty when she can't see it is the deepest kind of love.
Telling her what you love about her. Not only on birthdays or anniversaries. A random "I love how you laugh" on a normal Tuesday can make her whole week.
